title: AlertListRequest
description: The input of alert.list: how many alerts the caller would like, and where the page starts, as invoice.list's input is (step 13's README, decisions 1 to 5). The limit is a wish: DSoR cuts it down to its own maximum. The cursor is the last id of the page before, a proposal's id, a place in the caller's own company only. The caller names no company, no person, and no state: whom alerts.json names decides which alerts they see (step 38c's README, decisions D1 and D3). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that lists alerts.
